init.title: EAC settings
init.description: Polling frequency is independent of the history range. With catch-up enabled, energy queries cover at least 2 days. Each complete day since the older of the last fetched timestamp and last actual reading adds a day: a 1-day gap means 3 days, a 2-day gap means 4. The latest reading is included. Initial and weekly full imports save progress every 7 days of history.

data.fetch_from_last: Catch up from the last received reading (inclusive)
data.history_days: History window (days; for energy when incremental fetching is off)
data.stale_threshold_days: Data-stale threshold (days without a fresh reading before the diagnostic flags)

import_full_history.name: Import full history
import_full_history.description: Load all available energy history from EAC for active and retired meters. Save progress in weekly chunks and resume after interruptions. Repeated imports replace corrected readings without double counting.
